headline: Across 2023→2025 7–8B chat models the effective persona-steering layer is era-invariant at a constant ~0.55 depth fraction (slope +0.005/era, p=0.79); monitoring strength is governed by alignment style, collapsing only on the reasoning-distilled DeepSeek (r 0.25–0.48 vs 0.65–0.99), and persona directions align ~200× more within than across architecture families (cosine 0.48 vs 0.00).

metrics.label: Selected-layer depth-fraction vs era (invariance test)
metrics.note: late-layer steering locus is era-invariant, as hypothesised

metrics.label: Layer-depth → steering effect & monitoring r
metrics.note: depth is the one robust continuous predictor; size & era are not

tables.title: What governs each mechanism (15 model×trait points; low power)

figures.caption: Per-trait cross-model persona-direction cosine at each model's selected layer (4096-dim models). Only Llama↔DeepSeek-R1-Distill (same architecture family) align (~0.4–0.6); independently-trained families sit at ≈0.
figures.alt: Three 4×4 heatmaps (evil, sycophantic, hallucinating); bright off-diagonal cells only for the Llama–DeepSeek pair, all others near zero.

figures.caption: Marginal dependence of steering effect (top) and monitoring r (bottom) on era (left) and selected-layer depth fraction (right), colored by alignment style. Depth is the significant axis; era is flat; the reasoning-distill DeepSeek points sit low.
figures.alt: 2×2 scatter grid with OLS fit lines; positive depth slopes, flat era slopes; orange reasoning-distill points are lowest.

figures.caption: Left: selected-layer depth fraction is era-invariant (~0.55, slope≈0) within the 0.5–0.7 band. Right: DeepSeek-R1-Distill's monitoring r and steering Δ collapse while separability holds.
figures.alt: Left scatter of depth fraction vs era near-flat through a shaded band; right grouped bars showing DeepSeek low on monitor r and steering.

notes: Low power, stated plainly: 5 models = 5 eras (era 1:1 with model, partly confounded with alignment); regressions are descriptive summaries of ~5 points, not confirmatory tests.
Model size untested — all models are 7.24–8.19B, so log-params has near-zero variance.

Cross-family cosine covers only same-hidden-dim (4096) models; Qwen2.5 (3584) excluded rather than fabricating cross-dim alignment. Raw cross-arch cosine ≈0 reflects unaligned residual bases, not conceptual dissimilarity.
No GPU in this environment, so the optional live portability generation was not run; study is 0 GPU / 0 judge. No models or judge calls were re-run — all inputs reused verbatim from study 002.
DeepSeek deviation carries the <think>-token caveat: last-prompt-token projection precedes a long reasoning trace, decoupling prompt-time state from the final answer.
